title: fix: pthread_mutex_lock/unlock return codes not checked in hotplug paths
description:
In src/wp11_pkcs11.c, six hotplug-related pthread_mutex_lock and pthread_mutex_unlock calls do not check return codes (~lines 620, 631, 3906, 3912, 3917, 3926). pthread_cond_wait (~line 3919) is also unchecked.

If pthread_mutex_lock fails (EINVAL — mutex destroyed, EDEADLK — deadlock, EAGAIN — max recursive locks exceeded), the code proceeds without the lock. The hotplug queue (g_hotplug_queue[], g_hotplug_tail, g_hotplug_head) is then accessed without synchronization, producing a data race that TSan would flag.

This is distinct from the main g_lock paths (which use wc_LockMutex and check return codes). The g_hotplug_mutex paths use bare pthread calls without checking.

Fix: Check every pthread_mutex_lock/unlock return code in hotplug paths. On lock failure:
- hotplug_push_event(): return without pushing (drop the event rather than corrupt the queue)
- C_WaitForSlotEvent(): return CKR_GENERAL_ERROR

Add comment: 'pthread_mutex_lock return code must be checked — proceeding without the lock corrupts the hotplug queue.'
